sourceNotes: 应用活动支持自定义应用分类，并将所选时段和设备的报表导出为 Markdown 或 CSV
应用活动新增 30 天和 90 天本机保留期，云端副本继续保留
监控大屏新增看板模式，以及进程排行和系统健康只读 MCP 工具
改进活动日期导航与同步状态显示，支持从同步列表移除已停用的设备
打开更新窗口时刷新可用版本，安装前发现更高构建时要求重新确认
侧边栏在检测到 Telegram 时提供频道入口
修复移除同步设备后已确认设置回退，以及 CPU 进程排行首轮采样被误报为实时读数的问题

en: App Activity supports custom app categories and Markdown or CSV report exports for the selected period and device.
Adds 30-day and 90-day local retention options for App Activity. Cloud copies are preserved.
Adds a kiosk mode to the Monitoring Dashboard, plus read-only MCP tools for top processes and system health.
Improves activity date navigation and sync status, and lets you remove retired devices from the sync list. Synced activity records are preserved, and a removed Mac can rejoin when it syncs again.
Refreshes available releases when the update window opens and asks for confirmation again if a newer build is found before installation.
The sidebar offers a channel link when Telegram is installed.
Fixes accepted settings reverting after a sync device is removed, and prevents the first CPU process sample from being reported as live usage.
